name: Canyon Lake
seo_title: Canyon Lake Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 6 Events, 5 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Canyon Lake, TX: free Santa photos at Winter Wonderland, a church Christmas Family Fiesta, North Pole Village and the Sattler parade.
lede: Canyon Lake does Christmas the small-town way, with a Lions Club parade down FM 2673 in Sattler, a North Pole Village that volunteers build inside the CRRC Rec Center, and free mornings and evenings with Santa hosted by local churches and businesses.
celebrates: The Canyon Lake Area Chamber of Commerce sums up the season in three traditions: North Pole Village, the Christmas Parade and the Parade of Lights on the Lake, when boats dressed in lights cruise past with carolers. North Pole Village is the big one for kids. For six nights each December, CRRC of Canyon Lake turns its Rec Center on Mabel Jones Drive into a little town where children meet Santa and leave with a book and a plush toy. The Canyon Lake Noon Lions Club runs the Christmas Parade on FM 2673 in Sattler, and churches, the Tye Preston Memorial Library and local businesses fill the weekends around it.
lastyear: In 2025 the 47th annual Canyon Lake Noon Lions Christmas Parade rolled down FM 2673 at 11 am on a Saturday in December. FM 2673 closed for the parade, which lined up near the Ace Hardware and traveled west, and the Comal County Sheriff's Office posted the route map. That same Saturday was the last night of North Pole Village at the CRRC Rec Center, open from 5 to 8 pm, where entry was free for youth 18 and under and $5 for adults.
facts: Canyon Lake, first called Canyon Reservoir, sits on the Guadalupe River about twelve miles northwest of New Braunfels. The community that grew up around it is not a city at all. The Census Bureau counts it as one place that takes in the older settlements of Startzville, Sattler, Hancock and Cranes Mill, and it grew from 9,975 people in 1990 to 31,124 in 2020. The lake has about 80 miles of shoreline, and the Lions Club has managed the Christmas parade since 2015.
trains: The closest rail history to Canyon Lake is in New Braunfels. The International and Great Northern built through New Braunfels in 1880, and the Missouri, Kansas and Texas followed in 1900. Union Pacific now owns both lines, and the old depot on San Antonio Street is home to the New Braunfels Railroad Museum. The nearest Amtrak stations are San Marcos on the Texas Eagle and San Antonio, served by the Sunset Limited and Texas Eagle. Train fans can try the Texas Transportation Museum, the San Antonio Railroad Heritage Museum in Elmendorf or the Hill Country Flyer from Cedar Park.

Railroadiana inside the Elmendorf Public Library and a roster of locomotives and cabooses, open Saturdays.

traditions: Canyon Lake Noon Lions Christmas Parade
Floats and music roll down FM 2673 in Sattler; the Lions have sponsored the parade since 2008 and run it since 2015.
Six nights at the CRRC Rec Center with Santa photos, letters to Santa, cookie decorating and a free book and plush toy for every child.
Parade of Lights on the Lake
Boats dressed in Christmas lights cruise the lake with caroling, according to the Canyon Lake Area Chamber of Commerce.
CRRC opens North Pole Village on a Saturday morning for pancakes, sausage, juice and photos with Santa.
A free evening on FM 306 with professional Santa photos, the Grinch and hot cocoa, now in its third year.
The Tye Preston Memorial Library hosts a family gingerbread decorating contest and party in December.
kidfact: Long before Santa rode down FM 2673, dinosaurs walked around Canyon Lake. The Heritage Museum of the Texas Hill Country there is home to more than 300 dinosaur tracks.
faq: When is the Canyon Lake Christmas parade?

The Canyon Lake Noon Lions Christmas Parade is held on a Saturday morning in December, starting at 11 am on FM 2673 in Sattler. FM 2673 closes for the parade, so plan your parking and arrival time. The Lions Club posts each year's date on its parade page, and the county shares the route map on social media.
What is North Pole Village in Canyon Lake?

North Pole Village is CRRC of Canyon Lake's holiday village inside its Rec Center at 125 Mabel Jones Drive. For six nights in December, children meet Santa, write letters at the post office, decorate cookies and go home with a book and a plush toy. CRRC says more than 2,000 people came through the doors in one season.
Is there a lighted boat parade on Canyon Lake?

Yes. The Canyon Lake Area Chamber of Commerce lists the Parade of Lights on the Lake as one of the area's Christmas traditions, with boats dressed in lights and caroling. Check with the chamber for the date, since the boat parade is planned separately from the Lions Club parade on FM 2673.
Where can kids see Santa in Canyon Lake?

Santa visits North Pole Village and the Pancake Breakfast with Santa at the CRRC Rec Center, rides in the Lions Christmas Parade in Sattler, and stops by local events such as the Christmas Family Fiesta at North Shore United Methodist Church and Winter Wonderland at Empower Aesthetics, where photos with Santa are free.
How far is Canyon Lake from San Antonio?

The Canyon Lake community sits about 48 miles from San Antonio and 56 miles from Austin, according to the Handbook of Texas. The chamber says the lake is about 15 minutes from both Interstate 35 and Highway 281, which FM 306 connects, so families can pair a lake visit with Christmas events in New Braunfels or San Antonio.

highlights: Winter Wonderland at Empower Aesthetics on FM 306 is free on Saturday, December 19, from 6 to 9 pm, with free professional photos with Santa, the Grinch and hot cocoa.
North Shore United Methodist Church hosts a free Christmas Family Fiesta on Saturday, December 5, from 9:30 to 11 am, with ornament making, cookie decorating and a visit from Santa.

CRRC of Canyon Lake builds North Pole Village on six nights, December 3, 4, 5, 10, 11 and 12, free for children, with a free book and plush toy for every child; more than 2,000 people came last season.
The Canyon Lake Noon Lions Christmas Parade runs down FM 2673 in Sattler at 11 am on Saturday, December 12, and the Lions have managed it since 2015.
CRRC's Pancake Breakfast with Santa is Saturday, December 5, 8:30 to 11:30 am: adults $10, kids $5, tickets online.
